verdict.rationale: Runpod documents a REST API v1 covering all compute resources, a CLI (runpodctl) with explicit create/start/stop/terminate pod lifecycle commands, and two official MCP servers that let coding agents create Pods, deploy Serverless endpoints, transfer files, and manage resources in natural language via API keys or Sign-in-with-Runpod, without requiring console use. CLI also supports diagnosing issues and viewing account info, covering monitoring and teardown. missing for 10: explicit dedicated monitoring/logs API documentation, a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probe found 404s), and independent/hands-on confirmation that an agent can complete the full provision-monitor-run-teardown loop unattended.
